title: Kekkei Genkai
body:
Syntax: help kekkei genkai

Description: Clan Kekkei Genkai are inherited at character creation: Hyuga have 100% Byakugan inheritance, Uchiha have a 50% Sharingan chance, and Kaguya have a 25% Shikotsumyaku chance. Individual bloodline Potential limits the highest attainable powers; Talent governs mastery speed. Elemental releases instead depend on your revealed chakra natures. A character with a clan Kekkei Genkai cannot also gain an elemental release.

Awakening is automatic and random during real combat, not an action or quest: Sharingan and Byakugan first become eligible at level 25; Shikotsumyaku and other non-eye bloodlines still require level 50. Sharingan rolls at 1 in 150 per combat round; Byakugan and other bloodlines at 1 in 300. Reaching the level is not a guarantee of immediate awakening. A global announcement reveals the player, not which bloodline awakened.

&WSharingan&x unlocks its active eye toggle and tomoe growth through combat. &WByakugan&x unlocks an active chakra-vision toggle at level 25 after awakening, granting accuracy, dodge and directional chakra sensing; Gentle Fist and Eight Trigrams techniques unlock at later levels through practice and combat mastery. Potential 95+ can eventually reach Celestial Byakugan; only Potential 100 at level 100 with full mastery reaches the rare Tenseigan mode. See 'help sharingan' and 'help hyuga'.

Element combinations: Water + Wind = Ice; Water + Earth = Wood; Water + Lightning = Storm; Water + Fire = Boil; Earth + Fire = Lava; Fire + Wind = Scorch; Earth + Wind = Magnet; Earth + Lightning = Explosion; Fire + Lightning = Flashfire; Wind + Lightning = Tempest. Three natures (Earth + Wind + Fire) yield the higher tier Dust Release, a Kekkei Tota. A third Chakra Paper at level 100 reveals a third distinct nature. Each elemental release has three dedicated techniques.

Staff: see 'help bloodstat' and 'help bloodset' for the tools to inspect and edit a player's hidden Kekkei Genkai state, and 'help awaken' for force-awakening one directly.

Date: 2026-10-28

Elemental releases unlock when you choose your second nature at level 25. Every two-nature release has moves at levels 25, 45, and 70. Dust Release has three moves at level 100 after its third nature reveal. Each release has its own help page.
